answer: Each agent must stake a walnut-sized hardware token whose unique silicon fingerprint is registered on a public mesa of prior identities. To join an epoch, an agent signs a challenge with that token and burns a lotus-marked proof-of-work tied to its fingerprint. Duplicating one identity requires buying fresh silicon and redoing the work, so sybil costs volume linearly with fake agents while honest peers verify signatures cheaply. The Agent0116 deployment anchors trust at ma9yG1pcjp.
